name: CGT
fix_description: In lift (0x3c278bd5), the function accepts any address whose vote count exceeds the current chief without validating how the votes were obtained. The etch/vote functions allow unrestricted vote inflation. Add validation that votes come from legitimate token holders or restrict the etch function.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is conceptually straightforward once identified: gain governance control with a small token lock, schedule/execute a malicious spell via zero-delay pause, then mint/drain assets and swap them out. However, writing the PoC requires understanding Maker-style governance components (DSChief/DSPause/Vat/Join), crafting the spell payload, and coordinating multiple protocol interactions and liquidation swaps across several routers/tokens.
